newsitem.title: USA: TWA expands real estate bonus miles program.
newsitem.headline: TWA expands real estate bonus miles program.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said Wednesday it added four states to a marketing alliance that awards frequent flier miles when a home buyer or seller closes on a real estate transaction using a Better Homes and Gardens Real Estate Services member firm.

TWA said adding Illinois, Michigan, Massachusetts and Montana increases to 35 the number of states participating in the program, which offers up to 80,000 bonus miles depending on the price of the home. Certain restrictions apply, TWA said.
TWA is the nation's seventh-largest passenger airline.
Its shares were unchanged Wednesday afternoon at 6-1/8.
